[size=4][u]RRRR was originally a personal project that was retooled and adjusted for public release.  Please check below to see if this is the mod for you.[/u][/size][/center][/b][/size][b]
[/b][/b][list=1]
[*]I've massively expanded the magic lore and historical events which may or may not be accurate to SVE canon. I've also added a lot more context-specific lines for SVE characters such as Camilla which may or may not be in character.

[*]The mod assumes you will treat the Wizard nicely.  Some things won't really make sense if you treat him poorly, but that dialogue does exist.
[*]Expect long, lengthy events and dialogue. This is just personal preference. I like my dialogue extensive and insightful. If you don't, this isn't the mod for you. I generally do not suggest skipping any one time events because it may mess up event progression or you may be confused by references you haven't seen. Repeat events can be casually skipped.
[*]There is a lot of suggestive dialogue. The mod has gotten a lot spicier over time due to public demand. That said, there's still nothing explicit, but it is EXTREMELY suggestive with several pieces of content being flat out impossible to tone down. Generally, there will be dialogue options to opt-out of the extra extra spicy scenes, but your personal tolerance will vary.[b] [color=#fff2cc]Please toggle off "Spicer Content" if you would like the mod to lean more PG 13.[/color][/b] Please check the FAQ for a more detailed breakdown.

[*]There is some heavy dialogue. It doesn't get too dark, but some darker topics and events are mentioned occasionally. Most of it is reflective and about past events. The relationship between the farmer and Magnus is generally very supportive and healthy, but he does sometimes display a slightly more overprotective side. He always has the farmer's well-being and happiness as his utmost priority, however, but his long life-time of trauma is not easily dispelled, no matter how happy he  may be. [b]The plot scenario available starting in Y4 may potentially be distressing for some people so a toggle has been provided that will work mid-scenario to turn them off if needed.[/b] Please try it at your own digression.
[/list][b]

[b][center][size=5][img]https://i.gyazo.com/c01da89a18d35b37a2bb719c9f9c2938.png[/img][/size][color=#ff00ff][size=6]If Hidden Love Interest Mode﻿[/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=6] is [/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=6]on[/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=6],[u] Magnus will not accept a bouquet (or have the *single* tag) until [/u][/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]conditions are met.  [/u][/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=6][u]
You must commit if you decide to attempt hidden love interest mode. [/u][/size][size=4]
Toggling it off or on before unlocking his official Love Interest status may break the mechanic/reset heart levels if the toggle is not immediately restored to what it was before.[/size]
[/color][/center][/b][/b]RRRR features a new pseudo mechanic called "Hidden Love Interest Mode". It is designed to somewhat mimic hidden love interests found in Harvest Moon/Story of Seasons entries that have additional unlock requirements, but without the actual hassle of ridiculous tasks like throwing 100 cucumbers into a lake and downsides of a barely-present spouse. Like other hidden love interests, having this mode active hides the Wizard's eligibility as a bachelor until the correct conditions are met, which means [b]he will no longer appear to have the "single" tag beside his name or accept a bouquet [u]until conditions are met[/u].[/b]

Since it takes at least a full year cycle (spring to winter) to complete said conditions, a new "Unofficial Dating" relationship status has been added that triggers following the 9 heart confession event. While "unofficially dating" the Wizard, events and dialogue will reflect that change in relationship, making for a roughly comparable experience to normally dating in the game, but paced and supplemented with additional events and a lot of dialogue to keep the year interesting.

The aim is to add more weight on the relationship and better show Magnus' hesitation as a result of the trauma from his prior relationships when approaching something new with the Farmer while also addressing the lore added by SVE in regards to the Ministry of Magic. [b]

[/b][b]Requirement for unlocking the Wizard as a true love interest:
[/b][spoiler]Unlock the Nexus and Warp hexes in SVE[/spoiler][b]

If you're not sure what that requires, here is the full requirement to unlock the above:[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Complete the Community Centre/Joja equivalent
[*]Have the galaxy sword via the desert monument 
[*]Meet Alesia
[*]Remove the summit boulder via SVE Clint quest
[*]Complete the Ginger Island volcano dungeon
[/list][/spoiler]
[b]

[b][size=5]Largely obsolete. The mod has been retooled in the backend for allow for a much more flexible timing experience, but it is [color=#00ffff][u]recommended to play through 1 full ingame year (from spring 7th to winter 28th) and start to date/unofficially date him around late spring/summer before getting married in Y2 for the best experience.
[/u][/color]

Please refer below for the best marriage date for the best experience. [color=#00ffff][u]
Marriage dates priority for best experience:

[/u]Y2 Summer(The best) [/color]>[color=#00ff00]Y2 Early spring[/color] >[color=#ffff00]Y2 Fall/Late Spring[/color]> [color=#ff7700]Y3 early spring[/color] >[color=#ff0000]Y2 Winter[/color]>[color=#980000] All other dates not in winter [/color]>[color=#980000] Any other winters (The worst)[/color][color=#00ffff][u]
[/u][/color][/size]

[/b]I will keep this section around for people who would like a better idea of how I paced this mod however and what a typical playthrough should roughly look like.

[spoiler]
[b]Tips:[/b]
[list]
[*]Visit him at least once a day. I generally suggest doing so between 10am - 5pm, but really any time is okay in most instances (the tower is open from 6AM to 11pm). This will make sure you see all potential events.
[*]Actively begin mining through the year and collecting resources for house upgrade, ginger island boat repairs, and tool upgrades while collecting quartz for an easy gift option. Ideally, get void essence for faster heart progression.
[*]Get as deep enough in the mine to fight ghosts. They drop solar essence which is a loved gift
[*]Fishing is a great source of money if you fish off the shearwater bridge for puppyfish and butterfish.
[*]Getting fishing up to at least level 5 makes it possible to fish up frogs after 6pm on rainy days during spring which are a liked gift. Higher quality items give more points.
[*]Alternatively, buy the frog legs recipe from Marlon, upgrade house to tier 2 for kitchen and gift frog legs as a loved gift.
[*]Make field snacks for energy. You should have plenty of tree seeds from gathering wood. If that's not possible, try buying salads for 220g each at the saloon.
[*]Upgrade the axe to at least steel first so you can start collecting hardwood logs asap and have access to the secret woods for events. Respawning stumps in the secret woods only nets you 2 hardwood each stump, so it takes a while to build up without abusing slimes for mahogany seeds.
[*]Kill all the dust sprites you see. They have a chance to drop coffee beans which you can plant and turn into coffee for a speed boost.
[*]Always dig mountain artifact tiles. There is a chance to get dino eggs and ancient seeds. Ancient seeds in particular are an end goal crop. You can sometimes get these when fishing as well.
[*]Always check the travelling trader for [b]red cabbage seeds or red cabbage.[/b] There is no other ways to get it in year 1 outside of a lucky drop. There is a game setting that guarantees the red cabbage or red cabbage seed will spawn at the trader in Y1 (I think it was something like complete the community centre in year 1).
[/list][b]Timeline:[/b][list]
[*]Start the game on Hidden Love Interest Mode.
[*][color=#00ffff](Optional)Set birthday some time in late summer for the best general pacing assuming you follow this guide --> You can always adjust this on the fly if you [/color][color=#00ffff]missed the timing or opt to move it later in the year in general)[/color]
[*]Meet Magnus as soon as possible. Usually it's around day 6/7 of Y1 spring.
[*][color=#00ffff](Optional)Reach 4 hearts by flower dance --> Successfully dance with Magnus. Should be possible if you give him at least liked gifts and see 0 heart to 3 heart events while talking to him every day (rebalanced from original mod).  I've done some tests and it's entirely possible to get him to 4 hearts by the 21st of spring, assuming you get fishing up quick enough to catch at least gold quality frogs/ mine deep enough for solar or void essence/ give him frog legs dish.[b] This is probably the hardest to accomplish, but not mandatory, just nice.[/b][/color]
[*]Reach 9 hearts some time mid-summer --> Should be easy with flower dance boost and gifts + correct event answers. The friendship from later events are very generous.
[*]Accept his confession during his 9 heart event which takes place in the secret woods and start unofficially dating
[*][color=#00ffff](Optional)To see  "the Truth" event, play through through to Y1 Winter 17th while unofficially dating(Do not unlock the Nexus events. The easiest way to avoid unlocking them is to not complete the volcano dungeon assuming you have finished the community centre.)  and go with him to the Night Market as he suggests. Talk to him while there and select the dialogue option once it appears and then go to the tower the next day to trigger it. [/color]
[*]Complete Community Centre/Joja between winter Y1 and summer Y2 --> Should be fairly doable if actively working on it through the year.
[*]Complete Ginger Island Volcano dungeon after Winter 18th, but before the end of summer Y2 to finish unlocking the SVE Nexus events while still seeing "The Truth" events.
[*]Play through the Nexus/ Enchanted grove events. Magnus will give an ultimatum and be unlocked as an official love interest. 
[*]Begin officially begin dating him. ---> I suggest doing this ASAP
[*]Have a rain totem or wait for rain in spring Y2/Summer Y2 to buy mermaid pendant. 
[*][color=#00ffff](Optional)Marry him in before the end of summer Y2.[/color]
[*][color=#00ffff](Optional)Upgrade house to least tier 3 for nursery by fall Y2. [/color]
[*][color=#00ffff](Optional)Have child 1 by the end of Fall Y2. Have child 2 by mid Y3. [/color]
[*]Grats! You did it! Now just play as leisurely as you like!
[/list][/spoiler]

This is assuming the following mods have been updated to 1.6. Obviously, it wouldn't work if it wasn't.

[b][color=#ff0000]Any sort of mod that uses the Wizard as an exposition/story character - [/color][/b][/b]Obviously, the characterization can be anywhere from wildly OOC, to fairly similar. The likelihood is going to lean closer to wildly OOC just by the nature of how deeply RRRR explores his character. Please do not take anything not included within RRRR itself as canon to this version of the Wizard. [b]You will likely have [color=#ff0000]massively immersion breaking moments[/color], especially if you have a more intimate relationship at that moment where the other mod content comes in. Please approach with caution. 

Multiplayer: [/b]Kind of compatible. There are a lot of weird things about multiplayer that this sort of mod does not like (the same applies for SVE). This includes schedule changes, disposition changes, farmhouse events etc. Please check the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1456]FAQ[/url] for more details.

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520?tab=files]Happy Birthday Mod[/url]: [/b]I have included a compatibility content patch. Please unzip it into your happy birthday content folder and overwrite. I only provide spouse dialogue because birthday events are already handled by RRRR. 

[b][color=#ff0000][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10735]Event Limiter:[/url] DO NOT USE THIS OR SET THE LIMIT TO LIKE 6+. SERIOUSLY. [color=#ffffff]The mod is already held together with duct tape and glue. Don't test it.
[/color][/color][/b][color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff]
[b]Date Night/ Date Night Redux: [/b][/color][b]Not compatible[/b][color=#ffffff] on the sheer basis that RRRR already includes dramatically altered versions of date night events that work with Magnus as a person. All installing the actual mod date night would do is flood you with immersion breaking events. Please remove. [/color][/color]

[b]Ridgeside Village/East Scarp/ New location mod: [/b]I have not played either of these mods, but they should work for the most part. If I do, I may eventually add more compatibility such as festival appearances, and events, etc. I've been told Ridgeside conflicts-lorewise, however.

[b]Event Lookup: [/b]Technically fine, but [b][color=#ff0000]DO NOT USE IT TO TRY TO GAME RRRR OR TO MARK ANY EVENTS AS SEEN OR UNSEEN[/color][/b]. Seriously. You will break the mod. A lot of janky things were done in the backend to make sure the mod works properly so any sort of information you get from event lookup is flawed or confusing. [b]DO NOT ASSUME YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING. Leave it alone. SERIOUSLY. [/b]If you want to see if you're missing events, please check the event list below. 

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18144/]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url]﻿: Now officially out! [/b]It may be somewhat buggy as I don't know what progress is like for it.

[b]Any version of Romanceable Rasmodius:[color=#ff0000] Not compatible[/color] [/b]since RRRR already contains over 98% of the content in RomRas. [u]Please make sure to remove these other versions or it will cause issues like repeating events or awkward dialogue overwriting.
[/u]
[b]Pregnancy Role: [/b]Due to the way this mod is programmed in the back end, it actually ends up breaking the the pregnancy and child tokens content patcher provides which I use to determine if a child should be adopted or biological.[b] [color=#ff0000]As a result, all children will tagged as adoption.[/color][/b]If you would like to have biological children, please uninstall this mod and change your gender to female at the shrine of illusions (you can keep your appearance roughly the same). Please check the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1456]FAQ[/url] for more details.

[b]NPC Mods that have a lot of Wizard Lore/Relationships: [/b]Think Alecto, Juna, Lunna etc. [b]Largely [color=#ff0000]incompatible[/color] unless otherwise specified. [/b]There are flat out too many lore/personality conflicts to even attempt to resolve since the Wizard is a very popular exposition character and the RRRR edition has a very specific personality and way of speaking. Use at your own caution.

[b]LittleNPCs + Its content packs (such as farmer's children)[/b]/ [b]Any other children content mods[/b]: You could technically install these, but it will likely make no sense lore/story wise and be extremely immersion breaking because these mods tend to feature generic spouse dialogue. I personally decided against using them after trying them out for a while because it was that jarring. Please use at your own risk. 

[b]Content/ location mods: [/b]RRRR should be compatible with most mods, assuming that it doesn't touch the Wizard's content and doesn't overwrite the Wizard for whatever reason. I may consider adding compatibility for other content mods that don't alter the Wizard's romance content if there is enough demand and I personally like the mod. If you do attempt to use mods that overwrite the Wizard with this one, rename the [CP]RRRR folder inside the main folder with a z at the start to force it to load RRRR last (eg. z[CP]RRRR). This will have RRRR overwrite instead. In some specific cases, there may be clipping during events if maps are changed too much from the base SVE experience. Please install a no-clip mod if this is a concern you have.

[b]Farm Mods: [/b]All farm maps should work, but I recommend Flashshifter's grandpa's farm mod because there is an exclusive date tied to its private hotspring.

[b]Farmhouse Mods:  [color=#00ffff]The majority of functionality has been restored. [/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4]Due to the slight change in how stardew handles houses, if the mod author moved the location of the spouse room and nursery, I cannot make it compatible. For a list of which houses that I have personally checked to work, please check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1592]this list[/url]. I suggest having [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]noclip[/url] installed just in case.
[/color]
[b]Romance Mods: [/b]Similar to content mods. As long as it doesn't overwrite/can be disabled, it should be fine. Why would you want to
install this mod if you weren't set on romancing the Wizard though???

[b]Multiple Spouse Mods (like Free Love)[/b]: This mod will overwrite generic dialogue if the toggle is turned on. I have integrated unique courtship lines compatibility, but some lines will still be overwritten (eg, summit, welwick fortune telling etc) if the toggle is on. [color=#ff0000][b]Hidden Love Interest mode will not trigger if you have a spouse. [/b][/color]This was done specifically because Magnus would definitely not agree to having an affair with anyone and it would be difficult to account for specific mods, so just toggle it off if you insist on having multiple spouses okay? [b][u][color=#ffff00][size=4]Important: If you have more than one spouse (including roommates), the game will have issues realizing you're married to Magnus on random days. This will mean that[/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=4] post-marriage events do not trigger correctly [/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=4]as expected. There is no way to fix this outside of removing the multiple spouse mod.
[/size][/color][/u][/b]

[b][size=5][center][color=#00ffff][size=6]Please read through the config options before playing the mod. [/size][/color][/center][/size][/b]Some of these are important for making sure you format your experience correctly/to your liking. A shorter version of each description is viewable from the Generic Mod Menu in game, but they're explained in more detail here: 
[size=4]
[b]CONTENT[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Hidden Love Interest Mode﻿:[/b] The intended experience. Makes marrying the Wizard impossible until conditions are met. Please reference "Hidden Love Interest Mod" section for more details. Adds additional events and in-world context to events. I generally recommend keeping this on if you are starting a fresh save in most instances.    [color=#ff0000]Important: TOGGLING THIS IN THE MIDDLE OF A PLAYTHROUGH MAY CAUSE BUGS AND PREVENT SOME EVENTS FROM TRIGGERING. [b]Please check the FAQ for more information.[/b][/color]
[*][b]Override Generic Dialogue: [/b]Overrides generic universal dialogue. I have since integrated  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6358]custom fixed dialogue[/url]﻿ into RRRR. This will resolve most of the issues, but this toggle is still used to for fringe cases such as Welwick. Please turn it off if you do not plan on marrying Magnus.﻿[b] [color=#00ffff]CUSTOM FIXED DIALOGUE HAS A NEW VERSION! Please download it![/color][/b]
[*][b]Wizard Age Appearance:[/b] Changes some dialogue that refers to the Wizard's appearance. He will still be very old, this is just about the surface appearance.
[*][b]Birthday Season:[/b] What season the player's birthday is in. Used for events. Please do not set it on a festival day if you don't want potential bugs. For compatibility with the happy birthday mod, please read the compatibility section.
[*][b]Birthday Day:[/b] What day the player's birthday is on. Used for events. Please do not set it on a festival day if you don't want potential bugs. For compatibility with the happy birthday mod, please read the compatibility section.
[*][b]Darker Plot Events(Y4):[/b] RRRR heavily plays off and expands on one particular SVE event in Y4(This event has a huge number of other requirements). As a result, many of Magnus' darker tendencies and thought process are brought far more to the surface than the hints displayed through normal dialogue. If you would prefer a more light-hearted experience I suggest you turn this off. This plot thread is only somewhat resolved due to me waiting to see what SVE will do with it (if they do nothing, then I will come up with something myself eventually). [b][color=#ff0000]TW: Overt self-destructive  tendencies and vaguely hinted suicidal tendency implications. Potentially may possess triggering scenarios. (The farmer is briefly kidnapped and sealed into silence about the event.)[/color] [color=#00ffff]Toggling this off in the middle of said events will stop them from continuing so you may test it out to see if it's for you.[/color][/b]
[*][b]Spicier Content:[/b] Enables the most spicy of content. Nothing explicit, but the mod has gotten significantly more spicy due to public demand. Toggling it off will disable much of the more spicy content, but there will still be implications. [b]Please check the FAQ for more information.[/b]
[/list][b][size=4]VISUAL COMPONENTS[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Portrait Toggle: [/b]Used for portrait compatibility. Please change this based on the number of expressions in your portrait (32 is the default).[color=#ff0000] Important: [b]USING A PORTRAIT SET THAT HAS NOT BEEN EXPANDED To 32 EXPRESSIONS WILL LIKELY COMPROMISE YOUR EXPERIENCE. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.[/b][/color]
[*][b]Sprite: [/b]Please leave this on "Use included" if you would like to use the included sprite that matches the portrait. If you have a custom Wizard sprite you would like to use or want to turn off the sprite, change this to "Use custom". This is to ensure that RRRR doesn't accidentally overwrite your intended sprite. Please be aware there will be issues if the sprites aren't adapted to RRRR.
[*][b]Use Beach Sprites: [/b]Turning this off makes it so the beach sprite is never called. If you are using a custom sprite set that does not have a beach sprite and you have no desire to make a beach sprite, please toggle this off or the game will call an error. This toggle does not impact the portraits what so ever.[b] [color=#ff0000]If the pack you are using does not have beach sprites or the beach sprites are not loaded correctly, the game will crash if you leave this on. [/color][/b]
[*][b]Earring Colour:[/b] Changes the colour of Magnus' eventual earring gift in the event. Please pick which suit you better. To actually wear them in game, please install the Fashion sense pack and use the hand mirror. They are in the accessory slot and have a sparkle animation. Pick between gold and purple.[b]You will never get these earrings if Darker Plot Events are not active.[/b]
[*][b]Caroline and Pierre Expanded Portraits:[/b] Toggle this on to use the included slightly expanded Pierre and Caroline portraits. Compatible with vanilla, Poltergeister's slightly cute aesthetic, and my Gigi portraits. Please toggle this off if you're using another portrait set.
[*][b]Wizard Babies:[/b] Turn this on if you would like the included wizard baby sprites. Only really makes sense for biological children. For adopted children, I would suggest turning this off.
[*][b]Wizard Baby Hair Strip:[/b] Changes the strip of differently coloured hair the wizard babies have. Should match the farmer's natural hair colour. Does nothing if Wizard Babies isn't enabled.
[*][b]Wizard Baby Eye Colour:[/b] Changes the colour of the female child's eyes. Should match the farmer's natural eye colour. Does nothing if Wizard Babies isn't enabled.
[/list]
[b][size=4]POST MARRIAGE DATES[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Date Ask Percent Chance:[/b]Only used for post-marriage dates. Configure the chance Magnus will ask you to go on a date upon leaving the farmhouse each day after marriage. Default is 25%, but can be any percent 0-100. Set to 0 to disable the date events. Many dates have unlock conditions. The date is picked randomly from the pool of possible dates you have access to for that weather/season. Please check the list of events for specific details.
[*][b]Min Hearts Required:[/b]Only used for post-marriage dates. Change the minimum number of hearts required with Magnus for him to ask you on a date. Default is 10 hearts.
[*][b]Friendship Bonus:[/b] Only used for post-marriage dates. Change the amount of friendship received with Magnus if you go on a date with him. 'none' will disable any friendship bonuses, 'small' will increase friendship by 25 points (1/10 of a heart), 'medium' increases by 50 points (2/10 of a heart), and large increases by 100 points (4/10 of a heart).
[*][b]Dates on Festival Days: [/b]Only used for post-marriage dates. Enable/Disable being asked on a date on a festival day. Usually many areas are closed or off-limits on festival days, making it impossible for you to complete the date if asked. Enabling this will allow dates to be asked on a date with a festival, even if you won't be able to complete it. When disabled, dates will never be asked on every festival day (except the Night Market). Works on every vanilla festival and the two new Ridgeside Village festivals.
[/list]
